# Calibration baseline — real observed games

80 games, four different physical deck fixtures, 10 seeds each against mixed and randomized three-opponent compositions. 30-round horizon, adaptive pilot, safe provisional mode.

The opponent roles are abstract: no four-equivalent-AI fairness claim is possible from these data. See calibration.json for source-recorded first creature, second creature, combat damage, removal, combo clock, and terminal-turn summary, conditioned on observation when the event was not universal.

Original JSON outcome batches and full JSONL records remain attached to the GitHub Actions run.
